entries.name: Ultimatrix
entries.content:
despite being called a watch, bears a gauntlet-like band light green in color with four black lines around the band close to the dial and containing a black rectangular button and wrist couplings with the left and right side being black with two small green tubes. It had a gray dial (with the dial face being black in color) containing four small lines around it and the band extending up to almost half of the wearer's arm or forearm, but the central core's form remained the same. When the Ultimatrix is active a cylindrical tower pop up from the base of the Ultimatrix as well as the Omnitrix and shows the hologram of the aliens standing on the core, same as the Recalibrated Omnitrix.

When Albedo used it, the Ultimatrix had a red color scheme. After Ben took the Ultimatrix from Albedo, the Ultimatrix became green. This shows that the user can change the color scheme of the Ultimatrix.

The selection interface was identical to the Recalibrated Omnitrix's dial, with the Galvan tech logo changing color to reflect what mode the Ultimatrix was in.

Features
General
Just like the Omnitrix, the Ultimatrix mainly allowed for the user to transform into a numerous variety of alien life-forms that are each with their own unique powers and abilities (along with their weaknesses) and in a selection of alien DNA that are in groups of 10.
The Ultimatrix automatically reverted the user back into their normal form when they got sufficiently hurt or knocked out.
The Ultimatrix was able to access the Codon Stream's database to show which transformations have been activated over time
The Ultimatrix was able to scan human-alien hybrids and extract pure alien DNA from them.
The Ultimatrix could replace one of its DNA samples with someone else from the same species.
The Ultimatrix had a Master Control mode.
It allows unlimited access to all of the Ultimatrix's functions like access to all alien forms in the device and also, instant changes with no time limit unless all available power is used up.
It can be unlocked by via hacking.
Pressing the navy blue button on the gauntlet end makes the Ultimatrix increase in size, so it can be slipped off.
The Ultimatrix is waterproof and durable enough to take a bullet.
The Ultimatrix changed the aliens' eye color to match the device's core color.

Evolutionary Function
The Ultimatrix had the ability to evolve aliens into their Ultimate Form, granting them more powerful abilities. This was activated by pressing the Ultimatrix symbol as an alien, causing four gray spikes to grow from the dial and the selected alien to transform (often stylized as green bands of light washing over them).
The Evolutionary Function worked by placing the selected species in a simulation right down to the DNA, for an extended period of time (about a million years or so) in what is described as a "worst-case scenario"; the actual DNA is then simply modified to match the new DNA. This survival-of-the-fittest routine explains why the evolutions are more combat-centered than their normal forms.
Almost any DNA can be put through the Evolutionary Function.

Extensions
The Ultimatrix functioned as a GPS.
The Ultimatrix served as a communicator when transformed and not transformed, like the other Omnitrixes.
The Ultimatrix had a built-in Universal Translator and could also translate other Earth languages,but not animal languages.

Voice Command
The Ultimatrix had a Voice Command, just like the Recalibrated Omnitrix.
Ultimatrix User Access Voice Recognition Mode: Makes the Ultimatrix recognize the wearer and activates Voice Command Mode.
Ultimatrix Hard Reset: Resets the Ultimatrix.[citation needed]
Command Function Override Code 10: Overrides function.
Ultimatrix Self Destruct in (time): Command Code: 000 - Destruct 0: Activates Self-Destruct Mode.
Abort Self Destruct Code 10: Deactivates Self-Destruct Mode.
Ultimatrix Reset Code 10: Activates Reset Mode.
Ultimatrix Abort Reset Code 10: Deactivates Reset Mode.

Malfunctions
Much like the original Omnitrix, the Ultimatrix would sometimes transform the user into the wrong alien.
Furthermore, like the original Omnitrix, the Ultimatrix could be affected by manna.
The Ultimatrix displayed several signs that it was not completed properly. Azmuth even considered the Ultimatrix to be "pathetic workmanship" and not at all as advanced as the original Omnitrix.
Ultimatrix can quickly timeout from Ascalon.
The Ultimatrix couldn't detect outer dimensional creatures.
Unlike the original Omnitrix, the Ultimatrix did not possess the ability to restore the DNA of those corrupted by Xenocites, such as the Arachnachimp DNAliens.
The Evolutionary Function drained the Ultimatrix's battery quicker than regular transformations.

entries.name: Omnitrix
entries.content:
The Omnitrix resembles a digital wristwatch. Its faceplate is now square rather than round and has a white, green, and black color scheme. The faceplate is black with two green stripes forming an outline for the hourglass of the Galvan tech logo. When the faceplate is slid back, the Omnitrix's core is revealed.

Features
General
Just like the original Omnitrix and the Ultimatrix, the Omnitrix mainly allows for the user to alter their DNA at will and transform into a numerous variety of alien species that are each with their own unique powers and abilities (along with their weaknesses) and in a selection of alien DNA that is in groups of 10.
The Omnitrix has a quick-change feature that allows for the user to transform between alien forms while already transformed with or without touching the Omnitrix symbol. It also allows the user to transform back into normal when they are done using their transformation, causing it not to time out and allowing the user to transform again far quicker.
The Omnitrix has a Master Control, which would most likely be activated upon the user's 18th birthday.
The Omnitrix can synchronize with another Omnitrix if activated at the same time.
The Omnitrix does not rely on the Codon Stream for transformation. Instead, the DNA is stored within itself in a computerized form.
The Omnitrix can change the user's gender to adapt to another species.
The Omnitrix has Call mode which is used to communicate with the user using the device.
The Omnitrix is waterproof

Extensions
The Omnitrix has a 2-way communication system with Plumber Badges.
The Omnitrix can also record messages, similar to voicemail.
The Omnitrix has the functionalities of a regular digital watch.
The Omnitrix has a function were the user to stay transformed for an extended period of time without timing out.
The Omnitrix has a built-in Universal Translator and could also translate other Earth languages.
The Omnitrix has a distress signal function and homing device.
The Omnitrix has a security lock system so that it can only be used by the user, as well as an alternate identification program if changes by outside forces occur to the user.
The Omnitrix has a failsafe that kicks in the event that the user's life is in jeopardy. This feature turns them into the needed alien to survive.
The Omnitrix has failsafes installed by Azmuth that prevent Galvanic Mechamorphs from tampering with the device.
The Omnitrix can add extras to lifeforms to make them safer and more usable, such as Goop's Anti-Gravity Projector and NRG's containment suit.

Allocation
The Omnitrix symbol is positioned on different places for each alien whenever the user is transformed.

Voice Command
The Omnitrix can be controlled by Voice Command.
Omnitrix User Access Voice Recognition Mode: Makes the Omnitrix recognize the user.
Command Code 1010 Tennyson Benjamin Disengage Life-Form Lock: Disengages Life-Form lock.

Modes
Active Mode
Active Mode is the Omnitrix's default mode when idle. It is where the user can select the transformation they want to become; initiate the process of transforming; and stay in said transformation. The actual usage time is 15 minutes at a time. However, different factors and actions performed by the user can severely diminish the available usage time: most commonly if the user, while transformed, changes to another form. If the user slamming the core, this affects the time limit of a transformation, as the user could stay transformed for hours.

Recharge Mode
When the Omnitrix's usage time is fully depleted (i.e. "times out"), it goes into Recharge Mode: firstly warning of the timing out; then detransforming the user and locking all functions of Active Mode while the Omnitrix recharges.

Time Out
The Omnitrix is capable of detecting when it's host is in any sort of life-threatening distress. Specifically, it can instantly recharge to protect the user from a direct physical threat.

If the user is knocked out or hurt enough, the Omnitrix will revert them to their normal form.

Collect Mode
When a new DNA sample has been unlocked, or when the Omnitrix captures new DNA not present in the catalog, Collect Mode is activated. However, if the Omnitrix is far away from the detected sample, the Omnitrix's other functions will be disabled until the alien is scanned.

The Omnitrix symbol shooting green ray
When in alien form, the Omnitrix shoots out a green ray from the dial.

When the Omnitrix scans the DNA of an alien it doesn't have, it won't always be immediately unlocked in the arsenal.

Self-Destruct
The Omnitrix has a self-destruction mode. In this mode, the Omnitrix will begin a countdown, beeping as a warning that the mode has been activated. It can be enabled if settings are changed, and can be disabled if settings are changed again.

Randomizer
The Omnitrix has a randomizer function that works in one of two ways: either the user will continuously change between different aliens every few minutes before timing out, or they will turn into one random alien for an inconsistently short period of time before changing back.

Malfunctions
If the Omnitrix does mis-transform, it is because of the user slamming on the Omnitrix's core too hard and (inadvertently) the scroll pad.
Much like the Ultimatrix, the Omnitrix is not hack proof.
Much like the original Omnitrix, the Omnitrix does not have a failsafe against magic. If the Omnitrix symbol is bitten by magic creatures, such as rock monsters, the device will send a shockwave, distransform the user and will select only one alien.
Like the original Omnitrix, on occasion any damage the user sustains was retained when said user times out.
The DNA Scanner of the Omnitrix will attempt to scan any new DNA in the vicinity. If the DNA sample is too far away, then the Omnitrix will shut down all its other functions until it scans the new sample.
The user can be prevented from transforming by the Forever Knights DNA Scanner which would scan the transformations DNA before reveting the user.
Too many transformations and reversals will wear out the Omnitrix, causing it to go into a cooldown cycle.
The Omnitrix has no mind control protection.
The Omnitrix may stop working when frozen in time by a Chronosapien.
In addition to gaining all the powers and abilities of an alien, the user gains all the weaknesses of that alien as well. One common weakness includes being vulnerable to the alien's natural predator. The user is also susceptible to certain behaviors inherent to the alien he/she is transformed into, such as Swampfire's evolution, and the Swarm Gastronomy of Upchuck.
Upon activating the Randomizer Function, the user will constantly switch transformations at the most inopportune times, thereby putting them into potentially dangerous situations.
When exposed to electromagnetic interference from beings like Phil, it can make the Omnitrix transform the user into electrical aliens even when they select a different alien.

He has the same energy on his Omnitrix-shaped chest. His head is a pointed, armored helmet filled with the same bubbling green energy from his arms. He is mouthless.

Atomix wears the Omnitrix symbol on his green and white belt.

Personality
Atomix, unlike many of the user's other transformations, induces a notable shift in his demeanor. He adopts a highly formal and almost theatrical persona, characterized by a strong sense of justice and a penchant for grand pronouncements. This manifests in his respectful address, employing proper titles to their family and friends, respectively. Furthermore, he possesses a flair for dramatic flair, frequently naming his powerful attacks in a style reminiscent of anime heroes.

Atomix can create nuclear energy using his hands, which can do a massive amount of damage to its surroundings.

The way Atomix creates his nuclear blasts is by chanting "HAA-MEE-NA HAA-MEE-NA HAA-MEE-NA-HA!" It is not crucial for him to chant every attack, but doing so will focus an attack's power and cause substantially more damage.

Atomix is capable of flight and, as such, he can perform a flying ramming attack called the Fissile Whistle.

Atomix's hard body gives him substantial protection against physical attacks.

Atomix can glow in the dark.

Although he has never trained himself to do so, Atomix can reproduce gamma radiation.

Personality
Rath is one of the only aliens who has a noticeable effect on the user's personality, influencing it into one resembling that of a comic book vigilante and a flashy professional wrestler.

Rath almost always speaks in third person and a loud voice. Sometimes, when he becomes extremely angry, he mixes up metaphors (such as "a man's food is his castle" or "you just bit off an eye that's bigger than your stomach can chew"). He is aware that they do not make sense, but still continues to use them anyway.

Rath's muscle-over-brains mindset makes him needlessly argue with everyone around him. He even shouts at inanimate objects, like a hole he made in the ground, a stolen spaceship, gravity, water, fire, the Omnitrix and Ultimatrix for their malfunctions, the laser pointers, a giant ball of yarn, and a paper bag on his head, arguments of which were ridiculous and that occasionally lead him to harm both himself and others. Rath's confrontational attitude often gets him and his teammates into trouble.

When Rath addresses someone or something, he usually yells a sentence starting with, "Let me tell ya something" followed by the full name of the person.

Rath is very fearless to the point of recklessness.

Rath gets mad whenever someone mistakes him for a "kitty".

Frankenstrike has an appearance similar to the classic depiction by Boris Karloff of Victor Frankenstein's monster. He closely resembles an approximately seven-foot-tall muscular human male, with four fingers on each hand and black hair with sideburns. Most of his skin is a dull, greyish yellow; however, some areas on his body have a different skin tone, which are separated by scars and what resembles sutures, as if his body parts were sewn together. He wears metal gauntlets that end in fingerless gloves; metallic boots with grills on them; and dark, shiny pants with ribs that dip in a V-shape. He has many bolts that resemble flathead screws in places all over his upper body; and he has two large tower-shaped, conductor coil-like generators located on his upper back; though these are metallic-organic growths and not actually machines.

Frankenstrike's hair is cut much shorter, though his sideburns have increased in length in a mutton chops-style. His two-toned skin returns, the second tone now being a more withered dark grey. Patches of it are located on his entire left shoulder and left pectoral; his entire right forearm; the top of his right shoulder; one spot on the middle-right of his back; and nearly completely covering his neck and face, save for some of the right side of his face. Suturing connects all the patches, as well as a circular "cut" around his cranium. Frankenstrike's bolts are now much larger and stumpier; they are a copper color, with green lines stretching across and off the tips. There are now 3 bolts on his back; 6 for each side of his neck, shoulder, and elbow; and one on his belt, where the Omnitrix used to be. His conductors have moved up more from his back and cover his trapezius muscles. They are now a deep green, with white coils and light green bulbs at the tips. His belt and gauntlets are green, with small screws appearing along their white stripe and knuckles, respectively. His pants are very dark green and his boots are copper with light green slits. Frankenstrike's teeth are now yellowed and uneven, and bear out. The Omnitrix symbol is embedded in the flesh of his right pectoral, with several deep scars protruding from where it resides.

Whampire is a vampire-like alien with pale skin, green eyes, and sharp yellow teeth. He wears a black jumpsuit with a green chest and markings, black gloves with green fingers that possess sharp claws, and a green mask with spikes on it. His head is rather large and features green eyes, and his head spikes are part of his suit and they do not cover any part of his body. Whampire also has green flaps under his arms, which resemble the wings of a bat.

Whampire wears the Omnitrix symbol on his stomach.

Whampire's Corrupturas are crystalline entities, they are small, dark green, diamond-shaped objects with light green eyes, little horns, and black bat-like wings.

In his bat form, Whampire becomes a small black ball with wings of the same color and size. A miniature version of his face is on the front of his body.

While burning in sunlight, Whampire's clothes seem to burn off first, leaving his skin, which would be completely grey due to the sun, exposed before he himself burns.

Powers and Abilities
Quadrupedalism
Whampire's species are masters of controlling other beings. This gives him both the ability to hypnotize other beings through eye contact, and the ability to control beings by shooting Corrupturas at their foreheads. He can produce these small creatures from his mouth and can generate ones of different sizes to suit the size of his victim.

Whampire's Corrupturas are effective on other races of the Anur System.

Whampire can absorb and feed off the energy of living beings by sucking on them. He can even drain the life force of a Celestialsapien. If Whampire were to completely drain his victims of their energy, they would look similar to Darkstar's victims.

Whampire has the ability to fly and is highly agile while in flight.

Whampire has a certain level of enhanced strength, being able to hold his own against a mob of Anur Transyl citizens before eventually being overrun.

Whampire possesses enhanced durability.

Whampire can hang upside down like bats and real vampires using his prehensile feet.

Whampire can turn into a bat-like creature.

Whampire can see the internal structure, like the nerves and energy of his victims using his X-Ray vision.

Whampire can withstand other Vladats hypnotizing him depending on his willpower.

Whampire can create a huge sonic explosion as a last-resort means of self-defense that was powerful enough to send everyone flying in every direction.

Whampire can survive in the vacuum of space.

Like all Anur System aliens, Whampire can see in the dark.

Whampire possesses smoke mimicry.

Whampire can control undead aliens and inanimate objects that are supernaturally possessed, using his Corrupturas. In the case of the latter, the object would have to contain the possessor's consciousness.

Whampire can use Corrupturas as projectile weapons.

Whampire possesses enhanced smelling and enhanced hearing.

Apperance
Species: Orthopterran
Body: Humanoid Grasshopper
Crashhopper greatly resembles a mix between a grasshopper and a praying mantis with significantly large three-jointed hind limbs. He has a green film connected to the tibia and tarsus of his legs. He has green skin, which has a hue similar to Stinkfly, a large segmented horn on top of his head, and two smaller horns on the sides of his head where the eyes are placed. Each horn has three tiny spikes behind them. There are also three spikes on each forearm and the back of both tarsi on his legs. He has two sharp fingers, a thumb on each hand, and two light-colored claw-like toes on his feet along with one on the back. His chin is quite small with two lines, he has gill-like structures under his armpits, and his segmented neck extends from a green collar that is fused with the torso.

Crashhopper's suit represents green overalls with three black stripes and a green tip. The green stripe on his stomach has a large green hexagonal patch where the Omnitrix symbol is located and a smaller white stripe.

entries.name: Upchuck
entries.content:
Upchuck is the Omnitrix's DNA samples of the Perk and the Murk subspecies of Gourmand from the destroyed planet Peptos XI and currently Peptos XII.

Apperance
Species: Perk/Murk Gourmand
Home world: Peptos I - X (destroyed), Peptos XI (destroyed), Peptos XII
Body: Amoeba-like Humanoid

Perk Upchuck is a vaguely humanoid amoeba-like creature with green skin, six sprout-like growths on the back of his head, a dark-green patch of skin on his head, light-green skin on his face and belly and a crooked teeth overbite. He has whisker like lines on his face, and a green tail.

Murk Upchuck is a vaguely humanoid amoeba-like creature with swampy-green skin, a tanned stomach and muzzles, black sprouts and black-green spots on his tail, limbs, and back. His eyes are sharp and green, he has whisker-like lines, his teeth are more aligned with visibly sharp canine teeth and his tail is short and straightened, as opposed to Perk Upchuck's curled tail.

Murk Upchuck's claws are longer and bigger, his sprouts are brighter, and he has less spots on his body. He now has only two teeth in the shape of an underbite, and the markings on his face are thinner and contained by the face, no longer spanning the head.

both versions of Upchuck wears the Omnitrix on his stomach.

entries.name: Toepick
entries.content:
Toepick is the Omnitrix's DNA sample of an unknown species from an unknown planet.

Apperance
Body: Ogre
Equipment: Containment Helmet
Toepick is a greenish yellow-skinned, ogre-like alien with long and misshapen arms that have weed-like spikes coming out of them, pointy fingertips, and a visible belly button. He wears a simple pair of black briefs with a metal dark green waistline with white bolts on it. His eyes are glowing green and can be seen through the bars of a dark green metal cage helmet worn on his head. Inside his helmet is Toepick's terrifying face, which is supposed to resemble an eldritch horror. He also has a layer of tentacles that covers his true face.

Toepick's helmet has two horns protruding from the sides of it, and also a crest that resembles a toenail in shape. The cage's door has five bars, three of which are in the center of the door. It opens in two halves, with the lock in the very center of the door, staying on the right half. Connected to this cage is Toepick's armor, which wraps around his shoulders and goes halfway down his chest, and is connected to his briefs by chains.

Toepick's Omnitrix symbol is on the helmet's extension covering his chest, with two green metallic protrusions accompanying the symbol on both sides.

Powers and Abilities
Toepick's only known way of defeating his enemies is with his extremely scary face, which taps into the primordial fears locked in all beings' subconscious and primitive brains. Toepick's face is so hideously horrifying that almost no being in the known universe can look at it without being scared to the point of turning pale white. If someone were to take a photograph of Toepick's face, the picture would come out blurry, but it would still make people uneasy.

The sight of Toepick's face can cause adverse effects. The most common of these effects are the inducement of terror and insanity.

Toepick's face can also induce sickness and nausea.

Toepick can counteract forces that feed on fear.

Toepick has a type of layered multiphasic eyesight that makes his already mediocre vision even worse when looking at multidimensional or unknowable sights, meaning that he cannot be frightened by his own face if he were to look into anything reflective.

Toepick is able to bulge his eyes outwards.

When Toepick's helmet prepares to open, it releases a small amount of green gases as it depressurizes. It is also incredibly difficult to damage.

Toepick has a degree of enhanced strength, enough to lift a car.

Abilities
Nightmarish Face
Nightmarish Sounds
Fear Inducement
Gas Generation
Sharp Claws
Enhanced Strength
Enhanced Durability (helmet only)

entries.name: Pesky Dust
entries.content:
Pesky Dust is the Omnitrix's DNA sample of a Nemuina from the planet Nemunimos IV.

Apperance
Species: Nemuina
Home world: Nemunimos IV
Body: Fairy
Pesky Dust is a short, fairy-like alien with blue skin. He has purple fairy-like wings, pink spots and blue hair that sticks straight up. Pesky Dust wears a green dress-like outfit with black zigzags, the bottommost one of which is slightly asymmetrical. His hands have three fingers with white gloves on them and his feet have two toes. His eyes are green with feminine eyelines and has pink markings on his cheeks and chin.

Pesky Dust wears the Omnitrix symbol on his chest.

Powers and Abilities
Pesky Dust is capable of flight and possesses enhanced speed and agility thanks to his fairy-like wings. He can also leave behind a green trail while flying.

Pesky Dust can release a special kind of dust that makes his victims fall asleep.

Pesky Dust can enter and examine the dreams of other beings, which can be used as a form of interrogation or extracting information from a victim. However, they must be affected by Pesky Dust's sleep dust in order for him to enter their dreams.

Pesky Dust can control the dreams of multiple victims at once.

If Pesky Dust were to keep dousing a victim in his sleeping dust, they would end up sleeping forever.

Pesky Dust can manipulate a victim's dreams, causing them to have nightmares instead.

Abilities
Oneirokinesis
Sleep Dust Manipulation
Flight
Enhanced Speed (via Flight)
Enhanced Agility

entries.name: Echo Echo
entries.content:
Echo Echo, formerly known as Echo, is the Omnitrix's DNA sample of a Sonorosian from the planet Sonorosia.

Apperance
Species: Sonorosian
Home world: Sonorosia
Body: Humanoid
Equipment: Headphones
Echo Echo is a small, white humanoid made of silicon. His body is natural; although he strongly resembles a robot, he is neither it nor an animated containment suit. One of his most noticeable features is a square appendage resembling an MP3 player behind his back with a port on it, decorated with a 10 symbol and what looks like cassette tapes on his lower legs. The green circle-shaped indents on the back of Echo Echo's hands are sound holes which help him resonate, and the inside of his mouth is also green with lines that give it the appearance of an amplifier. He also wears headphones so he would not be hurt by his own sonic screams. The headphones are attached to the appendage on his back.

Echo Echo's eyes bulge out, he has two black stripes on both of his earplugs, which are more pronounced, his legs are stubby, he now has three toes, and the green circles on his hands are now bigger. He is also shorter and has a circular shape on his stomach and the tapes on his legs are now gone. His head is less round and is wider and the outlines of his mouth and eyes are thicker as well as his wires. He wears the Omnitrix symbol on his forehead.
